description_target.target_text: Big solid mono-color "cups" carve thin single-color-bounded notches into the noise. Each notch holds a marker line of color M (M = the color common to every notch, tie-broken by rarest globally). Fill every notch (size >= 3) entirely with M. wall mask: cells in a same-color component of size >= 8 regions of non-wall cells; keep those bounded by exactly one wall color M = color common to all notches, rarest globally Scene: dense noise field with 2-3 edge-anchored cups (two 2-thick slabs of one color enclosing a 1-wide sealed corridor open only at the grid edge); each corridor holds per-cup noise plus the shared marker M — the only color common to every corridor. Rule: fill every notch (sealed corridor) entirely with M.

racket_target.raw_code:
(rule! (lambda (g)
  ;; Big solid mono-color "cups" carve thin single-color-bounded notches into
  ;; the noise. Each notch holds a marker line of color M (M = the color common
  ;; to every notch, tie-broken by rarest globally). Fill every notch (size >= 3)
  ;; entirely with M.
  (let* ((h (rows g)) (w (cols g))
         (dirs (list (cons 1 0) (cons -1 0) (cons 0 1) (cons 0 -1))))
    (define (cv r c) (cell-at g r c))
    (define (inb r c) (and (>= r 0) (< r h) (>= c 0) (< c w)))
    (define gcount (make-hash))
    (for* ((r (range h)) (c (range w)))
      (hash-update! gcount (cv r c) add1 0))
    ;; wall mask: cells in a same-color component of size >= 8
    (define wall (make-hash))
    (define seenW (make-hash))
    (for* ((r (range h)) (c (range w)))
      (unless (hash-has-key? seenW (cons r c))
        (let ((col (cv r c)) (cells '()))
          (hash-set! seenW (cons r c) #t)
          (let loop ((stk (list (cons r c))))
            (when (pair? stk)
              (let* ((p (car stk)) (pr (car p)) (pc (cdr p)))
                (set! cells (cons p cells))
                (let ((nx (cdr stk)))
                  (for ((d dirs))
                    (let ((nr (+ pr (car d))) (nc (+ pc (cdr d))))
                      (when (and (inb nr nc)
                                 (not (hash-has-key? seenW (cons nr nc)))
                                 (= (cv nr nc) col))
                        (hash-set! seenW (cons nr nc) #t)
                        (set! nx (cons (cons nr nc) nx)))))
                  (loop nx)))))
          (when (>= (length cells) 8)
            (for ((p cells)) (hash-set! wall p #t))))))
    (define (wall? r c) (hash-has-key? wall (cons r c)))
    ;; regions of non-wall cells; keep those bounded by exactly one wall color
    (define seenR (make-hash))
    (define notches '())
    (for* ((r (range h)) (c (range w)))
      (when (and (not (wall? r c)) (not (hash-has-key? seenR (cons r c))))
        (let ((cells '()) (wcols (make-hash)))
          (hash-set! seenR (cons r c) #t)
          (let loop ((stk (list (cons r c))))
            (when (pair? stk)
              (let* ((p (car stk)) (pr (car p)) (pc (cdr p)))
                (set! cells (cons p cells))
                (let ((nx (cdr stk)))
                  (for ((d dirs))
                    (let ((nr (+ pr (car d))) (nc (+ pc (cdr d))))
                      (when (inb nr nc)
                        (if (wall? nr nc)
                            (hash-set! wcols (cv nr nc) #t)
                            (unless (hash-has-key? seenR (cons nr nc))
                              (hash-set! seenR (cons nr nc) #t)
                              (set! nx (cons (cons nr nc) nx)))))))
                  (loop nx)))))
          (when (= (hash-count wcols) 1)
            (set! notches (cons cells notches))))))
    ;; M = color common to all notches, rarest globally
    (define common #f)
    (for ((cells notches))
      (let ((cset (make-hash)))
        (for ((p cells)) (hash-set! cset (cv (car p) (cdr p)) #t))
        (if (not common)
            (set! common cset)
            (let ((nc (make-hash)))
              (for ((k (hash-keys common)))
                (when (hash-has-key? cset k) (hash-set! nc k #t)))
              (set! common nc)))))
    (define M
      (if (or (not common) (= (hash-count common) 0))
          -1
          (argmin (lambda (k) (hash-ref gcount k 0)) (hash-keys common))))
    (define fillset (make-hash))
    (when (>= M 0)
      (for ((cells notches))
        (when (>= (length cells) 3)
          (for ((p cells)) (hash-set! fillset p #t)))))
    (grid-from-fn h w
      (lambda (r c)
        (if (hash-has-key? fillset (cons r c)) M (cv r c)))))))
